explanation.text: Evidence from WHO 2024 X post (spans 4, 8, 16) and the WHO African Region report (span 15) confirms that 11 African countries together account for approximately two-thirds (about 66.7%) of the global malaria burden in 2024, which qualifies as 'most' estimated malaria cases worldwide. However, the MM
MMV facts & statistics 2025 (span 19) states that ten countries account for 66% of all malaria cases worldwide, but does not list eleven countries specifically.
A separate WHO/Target Malaria source (span 18) lists 11 African countries with approximately two-thirds of global malaria cases and deaths, but does not specify the year 2024.
